by the following members of the public:  Mr. Ridgeway.  (#7571) 
 
 Lease Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the Cheyenne Airport Board for land 
to be used for Street and  Alley for compost operations (20 19-2022 1% Sales Tax)  Mr. White 
moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $135,237.00, seconded by President Roybal.  Motion 
was carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. (#7572) 
 
 Lease Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the Cheyenne Airport Board for land 
to be used for the Weed and Pest Division (2019-2022 1% Sales Tax). Mr. White moved to approve 
in an amount not to exceed $15,457.00, seconded by President Roybal. Motion carried. Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body. (#7573) 
 
Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Cheyenne and Cal Kunkel of 
Cheyenne Fox Farm, LLC, to authorize filing of platting application(s) for City -owned lands for 
the purposes of vacating and replating Waterford Square Second Filing. (PUBLIC SERVICES 
COMMITTEE) Mr. Segrave reported this item was reviewed under other items for the agenda at 
the August 2, 20 22 Public Services Committee, therefore, provisions of Title 2 of City code have 
been met.  Mr. Segrave moved to approve, seconded by Mr. White.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” 
– all members of the governing body with the exception of Mr. Laybourn. (#7574)    
 
[CA]  Minimum Revenue Guaranteed Payment Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
the Cheyenne Regional Air Service Focus Team (CRAFT).  (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax 
Fund) - referred to Finance Committee. 
 
 [CA]  Memorandum of Understanding between the Ci ty of Cheyenne, Laramie County, and the 
Cheyenne Airport Board regarding the transfer of 2021 6 th Penny Funds.  (1% Specific Purpose 
Sales Tax) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Memorandum of Understanding  between the City of Cheyenne and Laramie County 
School District Number 1 for the School Resource Officers (SRO) Program.  (Revenue to City) – 
referred to Finance Committee.     
 
[CA] Contract Modification # 2 to Contract # 7427 between the City of Cheyenne and 
Russell+Mills Studios Inc., for the East Cheyenne Community Park Master Site Development 
Plan.  (Specific Purpose Sales Tax) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S -1-23 for a contract between the City of Cheyenne and Synergy 
Construction LLC for the Happy Jack Landfill Electrical Improvements Project.  (Solid Waste 
Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S-18-22 for a contract bet ween the City of Cheyenne and Johnson 
Sand & Gravel for the Landfill Tent Structure Demolition Project.  (Solid Waste Fund) – referred 
to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration to  Purchase between the City of Cheyenne and Farrwest Environmental 
Supply, Inc. for a XploIR handheld gas identification system handheld FT-IR spectrometer.  (2020 
State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) Grant) – referred to Finance Committee.    
  
[CA] Restaurant liquor license application filed with the City Clerk’s Office for Los Aguacates 
Inc. d/b/a Tres Amigos Family Mexican Restaurant, 1802 Dell Range Blvd., Suite 2, Cheyenne, 
WY.   Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Request to expand seating area for consumption relating to City of Cheyenne Bar & Grill 
Liquor License held by Paris West Restaurant and Bar, located at 1719 Central Avenue, Cheyenne, 
WY.  Mr. White moved to approve contingent upon City Engineering, Building, and Planning and 
Development requirements being met, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – 
all members of the governing body. 
 
Public comment was made by Mr. Ridgeway on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
The following members of the governing body made comments under other business – Dr. 
Aldrich, Mr. Johnson and Mr. White.    
 
 There being no further business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 7:01 p.m.   
 
        Submitted by, 
 
             
  
        Kristina F. Jones,   
City Clerk

MEETING: City Council Meeting | DATE: 2022-08-22 | CLIP_ID: 863 | SOURCE: cheyenne.granicus.com MinutesViewer clip 863

  
RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
August 22, 2022 
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting.  Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins, COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich , Bryan Cook, Ken Esquibel, 
Richard Johnson, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Mark Rinne , Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff White . 
Also present: Kristina F. Jones, City Clerk.  The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda.  (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to 
be routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion.  There will be no 
separate discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support 
by two other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered 
in its normal sequence on the agenda . Mr. Segrave moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Roybal.  
Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on August 8, 2022.  Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing for designating the use of excess 1% Specific 
Purpose Sales and Use Taxes from the May 2, 2017 Special Election.  There being no comment or 
input and purpose of the hearing having been met, Mayor Collins closed the public hearing. 
 
 ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending various sections of Chapter 13.12, Sewer 
System, of Title 13, Public Services, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming to 
allow for exceptions to sewage disposal requirements – postponed from August 8, 2022.  Reporting 
for Public Services Committee, Mr. Cook moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded 
by Mr. Segrave. Mr. Cook moved to amend by substitute dated August 16, 2022, seconded by Mr. 
Segrave.  Motion  to amend by substitute  carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body.  Main motion as amended by substitute carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body. Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Mayor Collins.    
(#4454) 
 
 ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending Ordinance No. 4411 Defining the Terms and 
Conditions of Employment for sworn officers of the Cheyenne Police Department for Fiscal Year 
2022-2023. Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. White moved to approve on third and final 
reading, seconded by Mr. Esquibel.  Mr. White moved to amend by substitute “Exhibit B” dated 
August 10, 2022, seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  Motion to amend by substitute exhibit carried. Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body.  Main motion as amended by substitute exhibit carried.  
Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. (#4455)  
 
ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending Chapter 1.16, Annexation and Infrastructure 
Improvements, of Title 1, General Provisions, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, 
Wyoming, to repeal annexation provisions, amend definitions, and modify processes . Mr. Cook 
moved to approve on third and final  reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried. Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body. (#4456) 
 
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from LI Light Industrial to CB Community Business 
for land located south of and adjacent to W Lincolnway .  Mr. Cook moved to approve on second 
reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body. 
 
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Pursuant to Section 2.2.2 Planned Development - 
Regulating Plan or Development Master Plan, Section 5.1.3 Official Zoning Map, and Section 
5.6.2 PUD - Planned Unit Development District of the Unified Development Code, amending 
Ordinance No. 3841  by modifying certain standards of the Adopted District, Planned Unit 
Development (PUD), for Pointe Plaza, 6th Filing, Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located 
to the northwest of the intersection of Gardenia Dr. and Powderhouse Rd.).   Mr. Cook moved to 
approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. Roybal.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members 
of the governing body.  Public comment was made by: Brad Emmons, AVI, agent for the applicant 
and Brenda Cowley.  Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. 
Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Cook, Mr. Esquibel, Dr. Rinne and Mr. Roybal. 
 
ORDINANCE – 2nd READING – Amending and repealing portions of Chapter 2.20, Police 
Department, and repealing Chapter 2.24, Police Pension Board and Fund, of Title 2, 
Administration and Personnel, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to 
eliminate obsolete provisions.  Mr. Cook moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr.  
White.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. 
 
ORDINANCE – 2nd READING – Amending Chapter 2.08, City Officers and Employees 
Generally, and amending and repealing portions of Chapter 2.28, Reserve Police Officers, of Title 
2, Administration and Personnel, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to 
update and revise the administration of the Reserve Police Officers Program and to extend 
administration over part -time Police Officers .  Mr. Cook moved to approve on second reading, 
seconded by Mr.  Segrave.  Comment s were made by the following members of the governing 
body: Mr. Johnson.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body.  
 
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending Section 10.52.010, Method of Parking, of 
Title 10, Vehicles and Traffic, of the Municipal Code  of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to 
authorize back-in angle parking as specified.   Mr. Cook moved to approve on second reading, 
seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body .  
Comments were made by the follow ing members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mr. 
Segrave. 
 
 
 
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending Chapter 2.04, Mayor and City Council, within 
Title 2, Administration and Personnel, and Chapter 12.04, Streets, Sidewalks and Driveways 
Generally, within Title 12, Streets, Sidewalks and Public Places, of the Municipal Code of the City 
of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to amend provision governing contract approvals.   Mr. White moved to 
approve on second reading, seconded by Mr.  Segrave.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all 
members of the governing body with the exception of Mr. Johnson voting “no”. 
 
ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from HR High -Density Residential to CB 
Community Busines s for land located north of and adjacent to the intersection of Dell Range 
Boulevard and Moran Avenue – referred to Public Services Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Cook) 
 
ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from MR Medium -Density Residential to NR -2 
Neighborhood Residential – Medium Density for land located south of 12 th Street, east of Logan 
Avenue – referred to Public Services Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Cook) 
 
ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending Section 2.32.020, Department Personnel, of 
Chapter 2.32, Fire Department, of Title 2, Administration and Personnel, to amend provision 
governing the appointment of Fire Department Personnel – referred to Public Services Committee. 
(Sponsor – Dr. Aldrich) 
  
 RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for 
Cheyenne Fox Farm, a replat of a portion of Waterford Square and a portion of Waterford Square, 
2nd Filing, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located east of Morrie Avenue, north of 
Fox Farm Road). Mr. Cook moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. White.  Mr. Cook moved to amend 
by substitute map dated August 15, 2022, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion to amend by substitute 
map carried.  Voting “yes” – all m embers of the governing body with the exception of Mr. 
Laybourn voting “no”.  Main motion as amended by substitute map carried.  Voting “yes” – all 
members of the governing body with the exception of Mr. Johnson and Mr. Laybourn voting “no”.  
Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Mayor Collins. (#6259) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Reappropriating the Fiscal Year 2022 Budget of the City of Cheyenne 
according to the provisions of W.S. §§ 16 -4-112 & 16 -4-113.  Motion (per Consent Agenda) 
carried. (#6260) 
 
 RESOLUTION – Designating the use of excess 1% Specific Purpose Sales and Use Taxes 
collected from the May 2, 2017 Special Election .  Mr. White moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. 
Aldrich. Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body with the exception of 
Mr. Johnson voting “no”. (#6261) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Supporting the Board of Public Utilities’ application to the Wyoming 
State Loan and Investment Board for a grant from the Water & Sewer ARPA Grant Program for  
the Water Reclamation Facilities (WRF) Hydraulic Capacity Project (Project) in the amount of  
 
 
$2,294,000.00 and authorizing the Director of the Board of Public Utilities to execute the 
application and all related documents (BOPU Sewer Enterprise Fund & SLIB ARPA Water & 
Sewer Grant).  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6262) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Supporting the Board of Public Utilities’ application to the Wyoming 
State Loan and Investment Board for a grant from t he Water & Sewer ARPA Grant Program for 
the North City Zone Improvements Project (Project) in the amount of $3,927,097.00 and 
authorizing the Director of the Board of Public Utilities to execute the application and all related 
documents (Wyoming Water Deve lopment Committee Funding & SLIB ARPA Water & Sewer 
Grant).   Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6263) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Permitting the possession of open containers within the Downtown 
Development District boundaries for the DDA/Visit Cheyenne “Halloween Pub Crawl” to be held 
on October 29, 2022.  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6264) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Permitting the possession of open containers within the Downtown 
Development District boundaries for the DDA/Visit Cheyenne “Com munity Appreciation Day” 
to be held on September 24, 2022.  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6265) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Expressing the support of the Governing Body for community efforts to 
remove racially restrictive real estate covenants.  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6266) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Comea 
Subdivision, 2 nd Filing, a replat of portions of Lots 6 thru 11, and Lots 12 thru 17, Block 404, 
Original City Plat, south of Lincoln Way, and north of the Union Pacific Railroad Right of Way, 
and Lot 1, Block 1, Comea Subdivision, being situated in a portion of the north east ¼ of Section 
1, Township 13 North, Range 67 West of the 6 th P.M., City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, 
Wyoming (located south of and adjacent to W Lincolnway) – referred to Public Services 
Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Cook)  
 
[CA]  Minimum Revenue Guaranteed Payment Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
the Cheyenne Regional Air Service Focus Team (CRAFT)  (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax 
Fund).  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed $500,000.00). (#7579) 
 
 Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, and the 
Cheyenne Airport Board  regarding the transfer of 2021 6 th Penny Funds (1% Specific Purpose 
Sales Tax).  Mr. White advised there was no recommendation from Finance Committee.  Mr. 
White moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $823,361.40, seconded by Mr . Roybal .  
Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body with the exception of  Mr. 
Johnson and Dr. Rinne voting “no”.  Comments were made by the following members of  the 
governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Johnson, Mr. Laybourn and Dr. Rinne. (#7580) 
 
[CA]  Memorandum of Understanding  between the City of Cheyenne and Laramie County 
School District Number 1 for the School Resource Officers (SRO) Program (Revenue to City ).  
Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#7581) 
 
[CA]  Owner and Design -Builder Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and FCI 
Constructors of Wyoming, LLC for finishing the Cheyenne Public Safety Center (2012 1% 
Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and StreamLink Software Inc. d/b/a AmpliFund 
for a multi-year contract for grant management software  (General Fund & American Rescue Plan 
Federal Recovery funds) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne, Transit Division,  and 
Laramie County to provide public transportation services to Laramie County Community College 
and for an area of Laramie County immediately adjacent to the City  (Revenue to the City) – 
referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Grant agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the Federal Transit Administration to 
fund Transit operations (ARP 5307 Grant) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Community Recreation & Events, and the 
Officials for Fun Club to officiate the 2022-2023 youth and adult volleyball programs (Recreation 
Programs Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
                                               
[CA]  Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Office of Youth Alternatives, and Laramie 
County for juvenile probation services (Revenue to the City) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Contract between the City of Cheyenne, Office of Youth Alternatives, and Laramie County 
for on-call crisis center services (Revenue to the City) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Contract Modification # 2 to Contract # 7427 between the City of Cheyenne and 
Russell+Mills Studios Inc., for the East Cheyenne Community Park Master Site Development Plan 
(Specific Purpose Sales Tax).  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed 
$36,865.00). (#7427) 
 
[CA] Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7545 between the City of Cheyenne and OpenGov 
Inc., for Software as a Service (SaaS) Solution for budgeting, financial management, procurement, 
citizen services, reporting, transparency, and asset management (American Rescue Plan Federal 
Recovery funds) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7157 between the City of Cheyenne and United 
Way of Laramie County to provide services to various community programs to allocate remaining 
portion of 10% “Excess Monies” to Human S ervices pursuant to Resolution #5607 (2015 -2018 
Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
                                 
[CA] Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7434 between the City of Cheyenne and United 
Way of Laramie County to provide services to various community programs to allocate funds 
pursuant to Resolution #5933 (2019 -2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) – referred to Finance 
Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S -1-23 for a contract between the City of Cheyenne and Synergy 
Construction LLC for the Happy Jack Landfill Electrical Improvements Project  (Solid Waste 
Fund). Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (accepted bid in an amount not to exceed 
$355,000.00). (#7582) 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S-18-22 for a contract between the City of Cheyenne and Johnson 
Sand & Gravel for the Landfill Tent Structure Demolition Projec t (Solid Waste Fund) .  Motion 
(per Consent Agenda) carried (accepted bid in an amount not to exceed $90,682.38). (#7583) 
 
 Consideration to  Purchase between the City of Cheyenne and Farrwest Environmental 
Supply, Inc. for a XploIR handheld gas identification system handheld FT-IR spectrometer (2020 
State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) Grant) .  Mr. White advised there was no 
recommendation fr om Finance Committee.  Mr. White moved to approve, seconded by Mr.  
Robyal.  Motion failed.  Voting “no” – all members of the governing body.  Comments were made 
by the following members of the governing body: Mayor Collins. 
 
 Appointments of Renee Hansen to the Laramie County Community Juvenile Service Joint 
Powers Board; Aaron Bentley to the Revolving Loan Fund Committee; and Richard Leslie and 
Ramon Moya to the Housing and Community Development Advisory Council.  Mr. Roybal moved 
to approve, seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body with the exception of Mayor Collins who did not vote (Mayoral appointments). 
 
 Reappointments of Dominic Valdez to the Revolving Loan Fund Committee; and Stephen 
Ganison to the Housing and Community Development Advisory Council.  Mr . Roybal moved to 
approve, seconded by Mr. White.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body with the exception of Mayor Collins who did not vote (Mayoral appointments). 
  
No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
No comments were made on the Revenue report as presented. 
 
Announcement was made that due to City offices being closed for the Labor Day holiday 
on Monday, September 5, 2022, regularly scheduled City Council Committee meetings will 
instead be held in the Municipal Building, Room 104, 2101 O’Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, W Y, and 
via electronic conference meetings as follows:  Finance Committee will meet Tuesday, September 
6, 2022 at Noon and Public Services Committee will meet Wednesday, September 7, 2022 at Noon 
 
The following members of the governing body made comments under other business : Dr. 
Aldrich, Mr. Johnson, Mr. Segrave and Mr. White. 
 
Mr. Segrave moved to meet in executive session pursuant to Wyoming Statute §16 -4-
405(a)(iii), seconded by Mr. White.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body.  Mayor Collins announced members would meet in executive session, not open to the public 
and stated there would be no action taken by the governing body as a result of the executive 
session, and that the regular City Council meeting would officially conclude at the close of the

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
October 10, 2022 
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting.  Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins, COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich , Bryan Cook, Ken Esquibel, 
Richard Johnson,  Pete Laybourn, Scott Roybal  (arriving at  6:26 p.m.),  Tom Segrave  and Jeff 
White.  Absent: Dr. Mark Rinne .  Also present: Kristina F. Jones , City Clerk.  The pledge of 
allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda.  (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to 
be routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion.  There will be no 
separate discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support 
by two other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered 
in its normal sequence on the agenda . Upon request by Mr. Laybourn and pursuant to support 
received by Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Johnson, item # 23(f) was removed from the Consent Agenda .  
Upon request by Mr. Laybourn and pursuant to support received by Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Johnson, 
item #25(a) was removed from the Consent Agenda.  Upon request by Mr. Laybourn and pursuant 
to support received by Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Johnson, item #25(b) was removed from the Consent 
Agenda.  Mr. Segrave moved to approve remaining items, seconded by Mr. White.  Motion carried.  
Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on September 26, 2022.  Motion 
(per Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
Mayor Collins opened a Public Hearing to determine whether compliance of annexation 
conditions required by Wyoming Statute §15-1-402 exist for about 1,280 acres of land situated in 
a portion of Sections 14, 23 and 24, Township 13 North, Range 67 West, and Section 19, Township 
13 North, Range 66 West, Laramie County, WY (located between Clear Creek Parkway and South 
Greeley Highway, south of C ollege Drive).  Public comment was made by: Mike Raner i, Rick 
Poach, Donn Edmunds, Jennifer Ro jas, Bruce Asay, Marla Richards and Susan Edgerton.  
Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mayor 
Collins.  There being no further comments or input, and purpose of the hearing having been met, 
Mayor Collins closed the public hearing. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a Public Hearing for a proposed trade of real property owned by the 
City of Cheyenne, described as a tract of land situated in the northeast quarter of Section 23, 
Township 13 North, Range 68 West of the 6 th P.M., Laramie County, Wyoming, consisting of 
20.84 acres with an appraised value of $52,000.00, to Mark Eisele for real property owned by 
Mark Eisele, described as a tract of land situated in the southwest quarter of Section 14, Township 
13 North, Range 68 West of the 6 th P.M., Laramie County, Wyoming, consisting of 13.85 acres 
with an appraised value of $27,000.00.   Comments were made by the following members of the 
governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mr. White.  There being no further comments or input, and 
purpose of the hearing having been met, Mayor Collins closed the public hearing.

Traffic, modifying time period for vehicle impoundment after immobilization .  Reporting for 
Public Services Committee, Mr. Cook moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by 
Mr. Roybal.  Mr. Cook moved to amend by substitute dated October 4, 2022, seconded by Mr.  
White.  Motion to amend by substitute carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body 
present with the exception of Mr. Segrave voting “no”.  Main motion as amended by substitute 
carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present  with the exception of Mr. 
Segrave voting “no”.  Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: 
Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Johnson and Mr. Segrave. (#4467)

Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from MUB Mixed -Use Business Emphasis to CB 
Community Business for land north of Pershing Boulevard, east of College Drive .  Mr. Cook 
moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion carried.  Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body present.  Public comment was made by: Ben Hornok, 
TC Solutions, Project Manager. (#4468)

ORDINANCE – 2nd READING – Amending Section 9.08.020, Annoying, Obscene or

Title 9, Public Peace and Welfare, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming,  
modifying the elements of the offense of annoying, obscene or threatening telephone calls . 
Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. White moved to approve on second reading, seconded by 
Dr. Aldrich.  Mr. White moved to amend by substitute dated October 3, 202 2, seconded by Dr. 
Aldrich.  Mr. White moved to  amend the substitute dated October 3, 2022, by reinserting the 
stricken language making it a municipal offense under 9.08.020 and prohibit the use of a telephone 
or other electronic device to attempt to extort money or other thing of value from another person, 
seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  Motion to amend the substitute carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of 
the governing body present.  Motion to amend by substitute as amended carried.   Voting “yes” – 
all members of the governing body present.   Main motion as amended by substitute as amended 
carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present.   Public comment was made 
by: Donn Edmund s, Marla Richards and Ben Hornok.  Comments were made by the follow ing 
members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Johnson.

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
            
January 3, 2023  
 
 The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne assembled for its First Regular Meeting for 
2023 on this date in Council Chambers  and via electronic conference meeting .  Welcoming 
comments were made by Mayor Collins. 
 
 Mayor Collins officially called the First Regular Meeting of the governing body to order 
at 12:15 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting.  Those present were: 
MAYOR – Patrick Collins; COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich , Bryan Cook, Ken 
Esquibel, Richard Johnson, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Mark Rinne, Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff 
White.  Also present was Kristina F. Jones, City Clerk.  The pledge of allegiance was recited.   
 
 Election of City Council President for 2023.  Mayor Collins stated that, pursuant to City 
Code, the mayor conducts the election for Council President but does not cast a vote.  Dr. Rinne 
moved to nominate and elect  Mr. Johnson as City Council President for 2023, seconded by Mr.  
Roybal.   Motion to nominate and elect Mr. Johnson as City Council President carried.    Voting 
“yes” -- all members of the governing body with the exception of  Mr. Segrave voting “no” and 
Mayor Collins who did not vote. 
 
 Election of City Council Vice President for 2023.  Mayor Collins stated that, pursuant to 
City Code, the mayor conducts the election for Council Vice -President but does not cast a vote.  
Dr. Rinne moved to nominate and elect M r. Esquibel as City Council Vice President for 2023, 
seconded by Mr. Roybal.  Motion to nominate and elect M r. Esquibel as City Council Vice 
President carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body with the exception of Mayor 
Collins who did not vote.  
 
 Approval of appointment of City Officials (pursuant to Title 2 of the Code of the City of 
Cheyenne) as follows: Charles W. Bloom, Planning and Development Director; Stefanie Boster, 
City Attorney; Bradley M. Bowen, Assistant City Treasurer (Board of Public Utilities) ; Thomas 
D.  Cobb, City Engineer; Mark Francisco, Chief of the Cheyenne Police Department ; Ronnald J. 
Jeffrey, Juvenile Court Judge; Kristina F. Jones, City Clerk/Assistant City Treasurer; John B. 
Kopper, Chief of Cheyenne Fire and Rescue Department; Robin L. Lockman, City Treasurer;  
Vicki Nemecek, Director of Public Works; Anthony R oss, Senior Municipal Court Judge; Jason 
M. Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director; and David E. Singleton, Municipal Court 
Judge.  Mayor Collins stated that, pursuant to state law, as these are Mayoral appointees, he would 
not be participating in discussion or voting on the proposed appointments.  Mr. Roybal moved to 
approve the appointees “en masse”, seconded by Mr. White.  Motion carried with all members of 
the governing body voting “yes” with the exception of Mayor Collins who did not vote.  Following 
announcement of the vote, Honorable Justice Kate Fox, Wyoming Supreme Court, administered 
the oath of appointed office to the City Officials. 
 
   
 
 There being no further business previously noted for the First Regular Meeting and purpose 
of the meeting have been met, the meeting was officially adjourned at 12:23 p.m. 
 
       Submitted by, 
 
 
       Kristina F. Jones, 
       City Clerk 
 
 This notice is available in alternative, accessible formats upon request.

Peggy Escamilla.  Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. 
Rinne and Mr. Roybal.     
 
Mayor Collins opened a Public Hearing to determine whether compliance of annexation 
conditions required by Wyoming Statute § 15 -1-402 exist for about 7.68 acres of land located in 
the N1/2N1/2, Section 12, T.13N., R.67W. of the 6th P.M., Laramie County, Wyoming (located 
east of Southwest Drive, north of I -80). Purpose of the hearing having been met, Mayor Collins 
closed the public hearing. Comment was made by the following member of the governing body: 
Dr. Aldrich. 
Mayor Collins opened a Public Hearing for a transfer of location of retail liquor license 
application filed with the City Clerk’s office for Poor Richard’s, from 1808 O’Neil Ave. to 1507 
Stillwater Ave., Unit D, Cheyenne, Wyoming.    Purpose of the hearing having been met, Mayor 
Collins closed the public hearing.  Mayor Collins announced the applicant has requested the 
application for transfer of location be withdrawn, therefore the application is not being referred to 
the Finance Committee.     
                
ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land 
located south of Atlantic Drive, east of Taft Avenue. Reporting for Public Services Committee , 
Mr. Cook moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion carried. 
Voting “yes”- all members of the governing body.  (#4481)

Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County HI Heavy Industrial and County A -2 
Agricultural to MR Medium Density Residential fo r land located south of Atlantic Drive, east of 
Taft Avenue.  Mr. Cook moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by  Mr. Segrave.

located south of 6th Street, east of College Drive.  Mr. Cook moved to approve on third and final 
reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body.  (#4483)   
                
ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County P Public to P Public for land located 
south of 6th Street, east of College Drive. Mr. Cook moved to approve on third and final reading, 
seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body.  
(#4484)

15.10, 15.12, 15.16, 15.22, 15.24 and 15.26 of Title 15, Buildings and Construction, of the

requirements and fees adopted by the city .  Reporting for Committee of the Whole, Mr. Johnson 
moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. Roybal.  Motion carried.  Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body with the exception of Mr. Johnson, Dr. Rinne and Mr. 
Segrave voting “no”. Public comment was made by Joe Patterson, Homes by Guardian, and Eric 
Adams, Gateway Construction.  Comments were made by the following members of the governing 
body:  Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Segrave.  (#4485)  
                
ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending Section 2.84.050, International Fire Code 
Board of Appeals, of Chapter 2.84, Miscellaneous Boards and Commissions, of Title 2, 
Administration and Personnel, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, 
pertaining to the International Fi re Code Board of Appeals .  Mr. Johnson moved to approve on 
third and final reading, seconded by Mr. Esquibel.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members 
of the governing body with the exception of Mr. Johnson, and Mr. Segrave voting “no”. (#4486) 
 
ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending various sections within Chapter 8.12, 
International Fire Code Adopted, of Title 8, Health and Safety, of the Municipal Code of the City 
of Cheyenne, Wyoming, updating the edition of the International Fire Code adopted by t he City 
and further amending as specified .  Mr. Johnson moved to approve on third and final reading, 
seconded by Mr. Roybal.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body with 
the exception of Mr. Johnson, and Mr. Segrave voting “no”. (#4487) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING –Creating Chapter 2.54, Boards and Commissions; 
Requirements Generally, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, setting the 
minimum standards by which boards and commissions conduct public business. Mr. Cook moved 
to approve on sec ond reading , seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Dr. Aldrich moved to postpone to 
January 23, 2023, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion failed.  Voting “yes” – Dr. Aldrich, Mayor 
Collins, Mr. Laybourn, Mr. Segrave and Mr. White.  Voting “no” – Mr. Cook, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. 
Johnson, Dr. Rinne and Mr. Roybal.  Main motion failed.  Voting “no” – Dr. Aldrich, Mayor 
Collins, Mr. Cook, Mr. Johnson, Dr. Rinne, Mr. Roybal, and Mr. White.   Voting “yes” – Mr. 
Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Segrave.   Comments were made by the follow ing members of 
the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Cook, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Johnson, Mr. Laybourn, Dr. Rinne 
and Mr. White. 
  
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending Ordinance No. 4455 defining the Terms and  
Conditions of Employment for sworn officers of the Cheyenne Police Department for Fiscal Year 
 2022-2023 by updating the department’s pay plan schedule as specified in Exhibit B relevant to  
cost-of-living adjustments for city employees . Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. White 
moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. Esquibel.  Motion carried. Voting “yes” -
all members of the governing body. 
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land  
located southwest of the intersection of Ridge Road and Holland Court  -- referred to Public 
Services Committee. (SPONSOR – MR. COOK) 
 
ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of  
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County A-1 Agriculture and Rural Residential 
to NR-3 Neighborhood Residential-High Density for land located southwest of the intersection of 
Ridge Road and Holland Court  -- referred to Public Services Committee . (SPONSOR – MR. 
COOK) 
 
ORDINANCE –1st READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land 
located east of Southwest Drive north of I -80 -- referred to Public Services Committee. 
(SPONSOR – MR. COOK) 
 
ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County LI Light Industrial to LI Light Industrial 
for land located east of Southwest Drive north of I -80 -- referred to Public Services Committee. 
(SPONSOR – MR. COOK) 
 
 
ORDINANCE –1st READING – Vacating West 19th Street, west of Grant Avenue, City of 
Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located south of Old Happy Jack Road, west of Missile 
Drive) -- referred to Public Services Committee. (SPONSOR – MR. COOK) 
  
 RESOLUTION – Authorizing a cost -of-living salary increase to el igible full -time 
employees of the City of Cheyenne (all city funds) .  Mr. White moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. 
Aldrich.  Mr. White moved to amend by substitute dated December 29, 202 2, seconded by Mr. 
Esquibel.  Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. Main motion, as 
amended, carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. (#6295) 
 
 RESOLUTION – Declining the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) 
entitlement grant between the City of Cheye nne and the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban 
Development (HUD).  Mr. White moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Johnson.  Mr. Roybal moved 
to postpone to January 23, 2023, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion  to postpone carried.  Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body. Public comment was made by:  Erin LeBlanc, Laramie 
County Senior Center Director; Amy Spieker, Laramie County Community Partnership Executive 
Director; Brenda Birkle, My Front Door Executive Director; Steve Ganison and Scott Hoversland, 
WCDA.  [Clerk’s note:  Mayor Collins recessed the meeting  briefly at 7:32 p.m. and reconvened 
the meeting at 7:38 p.m. Mayor Collins relinquished duties of the Chair to President Johnson at 
7:27 p.m. for one minute and resumed duties of the Chair at 7:28 p.m.]     
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Certifying compliance with Wyoming Statute § 15-1-402 for the City-
initiated annexation of tracts of land situated in portions of Sunny Side Addition and Sunnyside 
Addition Second Filing, Section 12, T. 13 N., E. 67 W., 6 th P.M., Laramie County,  Wyoming.

and Sanitary Sewer Services Agreements, for UMC Properties, LLC, for North Range Business 
Park 3rd Filing:  Lot 2, Block 9, Laramie County, Wyoming -- referred to Finance Committee.

P.M., and including a portion of public right-of-way dedicated with Sweetgrass, 7th Filing, City of 
Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located south of East Murray Drive wes t and adjacent to 
Sweetgrass Drive) -- referred to Public Services Committee.                
 
 Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Police 
Department, and the City of Laramie Police Department, for law enforcement extra-territorial 
assistance. Mr. White moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Roybal.  Mr. White moved to postpone 
to January 23, 2023, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  Motion to postpone carried. Voting “yes” - all 
members of the governing body. 
 
 Real Estate Purchase Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and James O. Woods, IV 
and Leah K. Woods, Trustees of the James O. Woods, IV, Living Trust dated July 19, 2017 and 
Leah K. Woods and James O. Woods, IV, Trustees of the Leah K. Woods Living Trust, dated July 
19, 2017 for the purchase of real property generally located on the east side of Parsons Place and 
north of US 30, consisting of approximately 59,330 square feet (2017 Specific Purpose Option 
Tax Fund). Mr. White moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $195,0 00.00, seconded by 
Dr. Aldrich.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes”- all members of the governing body. (#7662) 
 
 Memorandum of Understanding between the Cheyenne Police Department, Memorial 
Hospital of Laramie County d/b/a Cheyenne Regional Medical Center, Lar amie County Sheriff’s 
Department, Laramie County and Dr. Clair White of the University of Wyoming regarding the 
establishment and implementation of a Community -Based Law Enforcement and Behavioral 
Health Co -Response to behavioral health emergency calls wit hin Laramie County  (Wyoming 
Department of Health Grant ). Mr. White moved to approve, seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  Motion 
carried. Voting “yes”- all members of the governing body. (#7663) 
 
 Donation Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Union Pacific Railroad Company 
to accept a donation of selected heritage fleet railroad cars. Mr. White moved to approve, seconded 
by Mr. Esquibel.  Dr. Aldrich moved to amend to not to exceed a total of nine (9) cars, seconded 
by Mr. Laybourn.  Motion failed due to a tie vote.  Voting “no” – Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Johnson, Dr. 
Rinne, Mr. Roybal, and Mr. Segrave. Voting “yes” – Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Cook, Mr. 
Esquibel, and Mr. White. Main motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body 
with the exception of Dr. Aldrich and Mr. White  voting “no” .  Comments were made by the 
following members of the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, Dr. Rinne, 
Mr. Segrave and Mr. White.  (#7664)  
 
 Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Cheyenne Rail Hub, LLC, to provide for the 
temporary storage of railcars owned by the City of Cheyenne (2017 Specific Purpose Option Tax 
Fund and EDA Grant No. 05-79-06167).  Mr. White moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Segrave.  
Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body with the exception of Mr. 
Laybourn, Dr. Rinne and Mr. White voting “no”. Comments were made by the following members 
of the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Segrave. (#7665) 
 
[CA] Professional Service s Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and AVI Professional 
Corporation, for the Storey Boulevard Extension Project Design and Bidding/Construction 
Services Project (2019-2022 1% Optional Sales Tax Fund) -- referred to Finance Committee.  
 
[CA] Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Metropolitan 
Planning Organization (MPO), and BenchMark Engineers, P.C., for the Southwest Drive Corridor 
Plan (MPO Federal Funds) -- referred to Finance Committee.  
 
[CA] Memorandum of  Understanding between the City of Cheyenne and Dozzer, LLC, to 
authorize filing of platting application(s) for City-owned lands for the purpose of access and future 
development -- referred to Public Services Committee.  
 
[CA] Sub-Award Agreement between t he City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Fire Rescue and the 
Memorial Hospital of Laramie County to provide grant funded community paramedicine services. 
(WY Department of Health, Community Emergency Medical Services Grant Program) -- referred 
to Finance Committee.          
 
 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #E -10-23 for two (2) new four-door 2023 mid-size model SUVs, and 
one (1) new 2023 1 -ton crew cab full size pickup truck (SWAT truck) for the Cheyenne Police 
Department (2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) . Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried 
(accepted bid from Ken Garff Cheyenne, Cheyenne, in an amount not to exceed $229,382.14.  
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S-8-23 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Cheeney 
Landscaping, Inc., for the Cheyenne C emeteries Irrigation System Replacement Project  (2021 
Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund) -- referred to Finance Committee.  
 
No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
Announcement was made  that due to the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday, regularly 
scheduled City Council Committee meetings will instead be held follows:  Finance Committee 
will meet Tuesday, January 17, 2023 at Noon and Public Services Committee will meet 
Wednesday, January 18, 2023 at Noon.  Both meetings will be held at 2101 O’Neil Avenue, Room 
104 and via electronic conference meeting.   
 
Announcement was made that two Calcuttas benefitting Make-A-Wish Wyoming, will be 
held January 27 – January 29, 2023 at VFW 1881, 2826 E. 7 th St., Cheyenne, WY and March 14 
– March 19, 2023 at the Red Lion Hotel, 204 Fox Farm Rd., Cheyenne, WY (15% of proceeds go 
to the charity). 
 
Public comment was made by Jason Sanchez under Other Business.    
 
 There being no further business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 9:10 p.m.   
 
        Submitted by, 
 
             
  
        Kristina F. Jones,    
City Clerk 
 
This notice is available in alternative, accessible formats upon request. 
 
Published: Wyoming Tribune-Eagle 
  January 19, 2023

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
January 23, 2023  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting.  Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins, COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Bryan Cook,  Ken Esquibel, 
Richard Johnson, Pete Laybourn. Dr. Mark Rinne,  Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff White . 
Also present: Kristina F. Jones, City Clerk.  The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda.  (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to 
be routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion.  There will be no 
separate discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support 
by two other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered 
in its normal sequence on the agenda . Upon request by Mr.  Laybourn, and pursuant to support 
received by Mr. White and Dr. Aldrich, item #22(a) was removed from the Consent Agenda.  Mr. 
Esquibel moved to approve remaining items, seconded by  Mr. White.  Motion carried.  Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on January 9, 2023.  Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried.  
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending Ordinance No. 4455 defining the Terms and 
Conditions of Employment for sworn officers of the Cheyenne Police Department for Fiscal Year 
2022-2023 by updating the department’s pay plan schedule as specified in Exhibit B relevant to  
cost-of-living adjustments for city employees . Reporting for Finance Committee , Mr. Roybal 
moved to approve on third and final  reading seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried. Voting 
“yes” -all members of the governing body. (#4488) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land  
located southwest of the intersection of Ridge Road and Holland Court.  Reporting for Public 
Services Committee, Mr. Cook moved to approve on second reading , seconded by Mr. Segrave. 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” -- all members of the governing body.   Public comment was made 
by: Jon Cecil, Peggy Escamilla, Renee Fowler, Sharon Tuggle and Elizabeth Staples.  Comments 
were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, M r. 
Esquibel and Mr. Segrave. 
  
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City  of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County A-1 Agriculture and Rural Residential 
to NR-3 Neighborhood Residential-High Density for land located southwest of the intersection of 
Ridge Road and Holland Court .  Mr. Cook advised there was no recommendation from Public 
Services Committee.  Mr. Cook moved to approve on second reading , seconded by Mr. Roybal. 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – Mayor Collins, Mr. Cook, Mr. Johnson, Mr. Roybal, Mr. Segrave 
and Mr. White . Voting “no” - Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn and Dr.  Rinne.  Public 
comment was made by: Jon Cecil, Peggy Escamilla, Rebecca Murchie, Shar on Tuggle, Kristi 
Barrowman, Janette Wallace, Roger Alexander, Brad Emmons, AVI, Agent for the applicant, 
Jason Stephen, Gateway Construction, Paul Ricketts, Amber Raegan, Chris Rummel and Mathew 
Kasper.  Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, 
Mayor Collins, Mr. Cook, Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Segrave. 
 
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land 
located east of Southwest Drive north of I -80. Mr. Cook moved to approve on second reading , 
seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried. Voting “yes” - all members of the governing body. 
 
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County LI Light Industrial to LI Light Industrial 
for land located east of Southwest Drive north of I -80.  Mr. Cook moved to approve on second 
reading, seconded by Mr.  White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” -all members of the governing 
body. 
 
ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Vacating West 19 th Street, west of Grant Avenue, City 
of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located south of Old Happy Jack Road, west of Missile 
Drive).  Mr. Cook moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried. 
Voting “yes” -all members of the governing body. 
 
 RESOLUTION – Declining the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) 
entitlement grant between the City of Cheyenne and the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban 
Development (HUD)  (Postponed from January 9, 2023) .  Mr. Roybal advised there was no 
recommendation from Finance Committee.  Mr. Roybal moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Segrave. 
Motion failed.  Voting “yes” – Mayor Collins, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Johnson and Mr. Segrave.  Voting 
“no” – Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Cook, Mr. Laybourn, Dr. Rinne, Mr. Roybal and Mr. White.  Public 
comment was made by: Scott Hoversland, WCDA, Dan  Dorsch, Executive Director, Habitat for 
Humanity of Laramie County, Brenda Birkle, Executive Director, My Fro nt Door, Julie Gliem, 
Cheyenne Landlord Association  and S teve Ganison . Comments were made by the following 
members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, Dr. 
Rinne and Mr. Roybal.    
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Approving Water and Sanitary Sewer Services, by Outside User Water 
and Sanitary Sewer Services Agreements, for UMC Properties, LLC, for North Range Business 
Park 3rd Filing:  Lot 2, Block 9, Laramie County, Wyoming.  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. 
(#6297) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for the 
Maltese Cross, situated in the W1/2 of Section 16, Township 13 North, Range 66 West of the 6 th 
P.M., and including a portion of public right-of way dedicated with Sweetgrass, 7th Filing, City of

Sweetgrass Drive). Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6298) 
 
 
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Dell

Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located southwest of the intersection of R idge Road and

[CA]  RESOLUTION – Reappropriating the Fiscal Year 2023 Budget of the City of Cheyenne

(SPONSOR – MR. WHITE)  
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Directing City staff to prepare a Memorandum of Understanding

[CA]  RESOLUTION – Expressing the support of the Governing Body and directing City staff

ESQUIBEL, MR. JOHNSON, MR. ROYBAL, AND MR. SEGRAVE). 
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Authorizing the submission of an application to the State Loan and

behalf of the Governing Body for the City of Cheyenne for the purpose of providing critically 
needed flood control at East Dell Range Boulevard and Van Buren Avenue  – referred to Finance 
Committee.  (SPONSOR – MR. WHITE)              
 
 Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Police 
Department, and the City of Laramie Police Department, for law enforcement extra -territorial 
assistance. Mr. Roybal moved to approve, seconded by Mr. White.  Mr. Roybal moved to amend 
by substitute dated January 17, 2023, seconded by Mr.  White. Motion to amend by subs titute 
carried. Voting “yes” - all members of governing body. Main motion as amended by substitute 
carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body.   Comments we re made by the 
following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mayor Collins. (#7674)  
 
[CA] Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and AVI Professional 
Corporation, for the Storey  Boulevard Extension Project Design and Bidding/Construction 
Services Project.  (2019-2022 1% Optional Sales Tax Fund) Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried 
(in an amount not to exceed $175,747.50). (#7675)  
 
[CA] Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Metropolitan

Plan. (MPO Federal Funds)  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried  (in an amount not to exceed 
$116,480.00). (#7676) 
 
[CA] Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne and Dozzer, LLC, to 
authorize filing of platting application(s) for City-owned lands for the purpose of access and future 
development.) Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#7677) 
 
[CA] Sub-Award Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Fire Rescue and the 
Memorial Hospital of Laramie County to provide grant funded community paramedicine services. 
(WY Department of Health, Community Emergency Medical Services Grant Program).  Motion 
(per Consent Agenda) carried. (#7678) 
 
[CA]  Real Estate Purchase Agreement between Keizer Inc. and the City of Cheyenne for the 
purchase of real property generally located south of Atlantic Drive, between Cottonwood Drive 
and Centennial Drive and north of the Union Pacific Railroad, Laramie County, consisting of 
approximately 4.01 acres, more or less  (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund)  -- referred to 
Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Trihydro Corporation 
for the Landfill Methane Mitigation Work Plan Implementation (Solid Waste Fund) -- referred to 
Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7590-Owner and Design -Builder Agreement 
between the City of Cheyenne and FCI Constructors of Wyoming, LLC, for finishing the 
Cheyenne Public Safety Center (2012 & 2017 Specific Purpose Option Tax Funds)  -- referred to 
Finance Committee. 
 
 Consideration of Bid #S-8-23 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Cheeney 
Landscaping, Inc., for the Cheyenne Cemeteries Irrigation System Replacement Project.  (2021 
Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund) . Mr. Roybal moved to approve in an amount not to exceed 
$2,068,800.00, seconded by Mr. White .  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body.  Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Mr. 
Laybourn and Mr. White. (#7679) 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -11-23 for fifty (50) trash receptacles for the City of Cheyenne, 
Community Recreation & Events Department (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund) -- referred 
to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S -3-23 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Pole 
Mountain Electric, Inc. for the 17th Street Lighting Improvements Phase II Project (2017 Specific 
Purpose Option Tax Fund) -- referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S -10-23 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and JTL 
Group, Inc., d/b/a Knife River for 2023 City Overlay Part #1  (2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax 
Fund and 2017 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund) -- referred to Finance Committee. 
 
 
 
Appointment of Robert Jarosh as Administrative Hearing Officer and legal counsel for the 
Governing Body for services related to a contested case hearing.  Mr. Segrave moved to approve, 
seconded by Mr.  White.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body . 
Comment was made by the following member of the governing body: Mayor Collins. 
 
Appointment of Robin Bocanegra to the Housing and Community Development Advisory 
Council. Mr. Roybal moved to approve, seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” 
– all members of the governing body with the exception of Mayor Collins who did not vote 
(mayoral appointment). 
 
No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
No comments were made on the Revenue Report as presented. 
 
Announcement was made that a Calcutta benefitting Make-A-Wish Wyoming, will be held 
February 3 – February 4, 2023 at Red Lion Hotel and Conference Center, 204 W. Fox Farm Rd., 
Cheyenne, WY (10% of proceeds go to the charity). 
 
Announcement was made of a Public Hearing to be held February 13, 2023 at 6:00 p.m. in

meeting, for a transfer of ownership of retail liquor license application filed with the City Clerk’s 
Office for Wyoming Horse Racing, LLC d/b/a Horse Palace, 6421 Speer Rd., Cheyenne, WY 
(license currently held by Poor Richard’s d/b/a Poor Richard’s). 
 
The following member of the governing body made comment under other business:  Dr.

minutes_text:
MEETING: Special City Council Meeting | DATE: 2023-02-16 | CLIP_ID: 893 | SOURCE: cheyenne.granicus.com MinutesViewer clip 893

   
RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
February 16, 2023  
 
 The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in special session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Committee Room 104, 2101 O’Neil Ave, and via electronic conference meeting, 
for the purpose of collective labor bargaining with the Cheyenne Professional Fire fighters, 
International Association of Firefighters, Local No. 279.  Present were: MAYOR – Patrick Collins, 
COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Bryan Cook (arriving at 6:34 p.m. during 
executive session), Ken Esquibel, Richard Johnson, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Mark Rinne, Scott Roybal, 
Tom Segrave and Jeff White.  Also present: Kristina F. Jones, City Clerk; Stefanie Boster, City 
Attorney; Jo Jordan, Legal Assistant, City Attorney’s Office; Robin Lockman, City Treasurer, and 
Chief John Kopper, Cheyenne Fire and Rescue.  The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
Mayor Collins advised the meeting would be audio recorded and available on Facebook 
live and stated that Wyoming State Statute §16-4-405(a)(x) of the Public Meetings Act allows the 
governing body to meet in executive session to consider or tender offers regarding salaries, wages 
or other terms and conditions of employment during negotiations with the fire fighters union and 
that any motion approved by the governing body to move into executive session during the special 
meetings would be pursuant to this section of statute.    
 
Mayor Collins provided  opening comments noting he has been meeting with the Fire 
Department for labor management discussions which have resulted in a better understanding of 
the functions of their department.  Mayor Collins expressed appreciation to Chief John Kopper for 
the work he does with the Union and his representation of the Fire Department and to members of 
the Union’s negotiation team.  The proposed Ground Rules were agreed upon and signed by the 
City and Union. [Cle rk’s note: City’s Spokespersons are: Mayor Patrick Collins, City Attorney 
Stefanie Boster and City Council President Richard Johnson.  Union’s Spokespersons are: Neil 
Durante, Vincent McQueeney and Kelsey Raile.]  
 
Following signing of the Ground Rules by Mayor Collins and Union Spokesperson Vincent 
McQueeney both parties presented their respective proposed Collective Bargaining Agreement 
proposals.  Mayor Collins briefly reviewed the City’s proposal which included changes to the 
following areas and Sections: update cover page; update table of contents; Section 2 -Definitions; 
Section 3-Exclusive Bargaining Agent ; Section 4 -Term of Agreement ; Section 8 -Grievance 
Procedures; Section 12 -Union Representation ; Section 13 -Management Rights ; Section 15 -
Department Staffing; Section 19 -Inclement Weather; Section 21-Classification of Employment 
and Basic Wages; Section 22-Overtime; Section 23-Working in a Higher Job Rank ; Section 24-
Conversion of Benefits ; Section 2 6-Vacation/EOD; Section 31 -Uniforms; Section 32 -Personal 
Protective Equipment; and Section 42-Longevity.  Mr. McQueeney briefly reviewed the Union’s 
proposal which included changes to the following areas and Sections: update cover page; update 
table of con tents; Section 2 -Definitions, Section 15-Department Staffing; Section 20 -Holidays; 
   
Section 21 -Classification of Employment and Basic Wages; Section 22 -Overtime; Section 23 -
Working in a Higher Job Rank; and Section 26-Vacation/EOD  
 
Mr. Johnson moved to meet in executive session, seconded by Mr. Roybal.  Motion carried.  
Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body  present.  Those present in executive session 
were:  All members of the governing body; Stefanie Boster, City Attorney; Kristina F. Jones, City 
Clerk; Robin Lockman, City Treasurer; Chief John Kopper, Cheyenne Fire & Rescue; and Jo 
Jordan, City Attorney Legal Assistant.  [Clerk’s Note: executive session convened at 6:27 p.m.] 
 
 Following closure of the executive session, Mayor Collins reconvened the regular meeting 
at 7:02 p.m.  Union Spokesperson Mr. McQueeney echoed the importance of the labor 
management discussions  that occur throughout the year leading up to negotiations.  Mr. 
McQueeney announced the Union’s acceptance of the City’s proposed agreement as written.  
Mayor Collins announced the City’s acceptance of the Union’s proposed agreement as written.  
 
  There bein g no fur ther business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 7:05 p.m.  
 
 
       Submitted by, 
        
        
        
       Kristina F. Jones, City Clerk  
 
 
This notice is available in alternative, accessible formats upon request. 
 
Published: Wyoming Tribune-Eagle 
  February 25, 2023

Mr. Segrave and Mr. White. Main motion failed.  Voting “ yes” – Mayor Collins, Mr. Cook, Mr. 
Esquibel, Mr. Johnson, Mr. Roybal, Mr. Segrave and Mr. White. Voting “no” – Dr. Aldrich, Mr. 
Laybourn and Dr. Rinne.   After a brief recess at 7:26 p.m.,  Dr. Aldrich , having voted on the 
prevailing side of the main motion that failed, moved to reconsider the vote, seconded by Mr. 
Laybourn. Motion to reconsider carried.  Voting “yes” – Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins , Mr. Cook, 
Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Johnson, Mr. Laybourn and Mr. White.  Voting “no” – Dr. Rinne, Mr. Roybal 
and Mr. Segrave.  Dr. Aldrich moved to amend by changing the County A-1 Agricultural and Rural 
Residential zoning classification to MR Medium Density Residential, seconded by Mr. Laybourn.  
Mr. Roybal moved to postpone until March 13, 2023, seconded by Mr. Esq uibel.  Mr. Johnson 
called a point of order on the motion to postpone, and Mayor Collins advised the motion was 
appropriate.  Motion to postpone carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body.

 Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne and Arts Cheyenne for

 Professional Services Contract between the City of Cheyenne and Overstreet Homar &

not to exceed $7,200.00, seconded by Mr.  Esquibel.  Mr. White moved to amend by  substitute

Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body.  Main motion as amended carried.  Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body. (#7692) 
   
[CA] Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne and Laramie County for 
EOD, SWAT, and CNU Operations and Extraterritorial Law Enforcement assistance and 
activities.  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#7693) 
   
Donation Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Union Pacific Railroad Company 
to accept a donation of selected fleet railroad cars. Mr. White moved to approve, seconded by Mr. 
Roybal. Mr. White moved to  remove “Attachment A” and replace with the list of 4 cars to be 
accepted by the City, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body.   Mr. White moved to remove “Attachment C”, the Engineering Report & 
Proposal, seconded by Mr. Roybal.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body.  Main motion as twice amended carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body 
with the exception of Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Laybourn voting “no”.  Comments were made by the 
following members of the governi ng body: Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Collins and Mr. 
Segrave. (#7694) 
[CA] 2023-2025 Collective Labor Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Cheyenne 
Firefighters, Local Union No. 279, International Association of Firefighters – referred to Finance 
Committee.   
        
[CA] Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Board of 
Public Utilities and McGee, Hearne & Paiz, LLP to provide financial and compliance auditing 
services for the fiscal years ending June 30, 2023 and 2024 (General Fund) – referred to Finance 
Committee. 
 
[CA] Memorandum of Understa nding between the City of Cheyenne and Granite Peak 
Development, LP, Clear Creek Land Company, LLC, Laramie Land Holdings, LLC, Cheyenne 
Logistics Hub, LLC, and Swan Ranch LLC to memorialize the payment of past fees by the parties 
and to restate prior Development Agreements – referred to Public Services Committee.      
         
[CA] Consideration of Bid #E-12-23 for lift-equipped Transit vehicles for the City of Cheyenne, 
Transit Division.  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (accepted bid from Davey Coach, Sedalia, 
CO, in an amount not to exceed $1,282,573.99).  
         
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S -11-23 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and JTL 
Group Inc. d/b/a Knife River for the 2023 City Overlay Part #2 project .  Motion (per Consent 
Agenda) carried (accepted bid in an amount not to exceed $2,794,156.69). (#7695) 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S-9-23 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Welding 
& Machine Inc. for the Sanitation Division Transfer Station Welding Repairs project. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried (accepted bid in an amount not to exceed $108,041.54). (#7696) 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S-15-23 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Inman 
Roofing, Inc., for the Sanitation Transfer Station Reroof Project (Solid Waste Fund) – referred to 
Finance Committee.  
         
[CA] Consideration to purchase two (2) used SUV’s  for the City of Cheyenne, Compliance 
Department (2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee.   
         
[CA] Transfer of ownership of retail liquor license application filed with the City Clerk’s Office 
for Wyoming Horse Racing, LLC d/b/a Horse Palace, Lot 1, Block One, Swan Ranch Rail Park, 
16th Filing, Cheyenne, WY (license currently held by Poor Richard’s d/b/a Poor Richard’s).  
Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. 
        
No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
No comments were made on the Revenue Report as presented. 
 
Announcement was made of a Public Hearing  to be held March 13, 2023 at 6:00 p.m. in 
City Council Chambers, 2101 O’Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, WY, and via electronic conference 
meeting to determine whether compliance of annexation conditions required by Wyoming Statute 
§ 15-1-402 exist for about 3.47 acres of land located at 908 Southwest Drive, Laramie County, 
Wyoming (located west of Southwest Drive, south of I-80).   
 
 There being no further business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 8:38 p.m. 
         
        Submitted by, 
 
              
        Kristina F. Jones,    
City Clerk

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
March 13, 2023  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting.  Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins, COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Bryan Cook, Ken Esquibel, 
Richard Johnson, Pete Laybourn, Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff White . Absent: Dr. Mark 
Rinne.  Also present: Kylie Soden, Deputy City Clerk.  The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda.  (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to 
be routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion.  There will be no 
separate discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support 
by two other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered 
in its normal sequence on the agenda .  Mr. Segrave moved to approve, seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  
Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on February 27, 2023.  Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried.  
 
Mayor Collins opened a public hearing to determine whether compliance of annexation 
conditions required by Wyoming Statute § 15- 1-402 exist for about 3.47 acres of land located at 
908 Southwest Drive, Laramie County, Wyoming (located west of Southwest Drive, south of I -
80).  The purpose of the  hearing having been met, Mayor Collins closed the hearing.  Comment 
was made by the following member of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich.  
 
ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from County A-1 Agriculture and Rural Residential 
to NR-3 Neighborhood Residential-High Density for land located southwest of the intersection of 
Ridge Road and Holland Court (Postponed from February 27, 2023). Reporting for Public Services 
Committee, Mr. Cook advised there was no recommendation from the committee. Mr. Cook  
moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Mr. Cook moved to amend 
by changing the County A -1 Agricultural and Rural Residential zoning classification to MR 
Medium Density Residential, seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  Motion to amend failed. Voting “yes” – 
Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Cook, Mr. Laybourn and Mr. White.  Voting “no” – Mayor Collins, Mr. Esquibel, 
Mr. Johnson, Mr. Roybal and Mr. Segrave. Main motion failed (super majority required).  Voting 
“yes” – Mayor Collins, Mr. Cook, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Johnson, Mr. Roybal, Mr. Segrave and Mr. 
White. Vo ting “no” – Dr. Aldrich  and Mr. Laybourn.  Public comment was made by: Renee 
Fowler, Sam Weinstein, Vice President, Southeast Wyoming Builders Association, Jason Stephen, 
Bedrock Development, Roger Alexander, Amber Raegan, Steve Asky, JJ Chen, Wendy Volk, Jon 
Cecil, Elizabeth Stapel,  Dale Steen bergen, CEO/President, Greater Cheyenne Chamber of 
Commerce, Patrick Rudd, Peggy Escamilla, Rebecca  Murchie, Michael White, John Fender, 
President, Southeast Wyoming Builders Association, Janett e Wallace, Bedrock Development , 
Mike Sutton, Tasha Coryell, Min Ho, Jennifer Barley, CRMC, Rod Stone, Max Minnick, Pine 
Rock Realty,  Sharon Tuggle  and Ryan Whitehead .  Comments were made by the following 
members of the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins,  Mr. Cook, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. 
Johnson, Mr. Laybourn, Mr. Roybal, Mr. Segrave and Mr. White.  
 
ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending Section 1.3 of the Unified Development Code 
(UDC), amending the enforcement regulations of the UDC and making other conforming 
amendments.  Mr. Cook moved to approve on thir d and final reading, seconded by Mr. Johnson.  
Mr. Cook moved to amend by substitute dated March 6, 2023, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion 
to amend carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present .  Main motion as 
amended carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present.  Comment was made 
by the following member of the governing body: Mr. Laybourn. (#4493) 
 
ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from MUB Mixed-Use Business and CB Community 
Business to CB Co mmunity Business for land located between Old Happy Jack Road and 
Lincolnway, west of Missile Drive .  Mr. Cook  moved to approve on third and final  reading, 
seconded by Mr . Segrave.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body 
present. (#4494) 
 
ORDINANCE – 2nd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, tracts of

12, T. 13 N., R. 67 W., 6 th P.M., Laramie County Wyoming, generally located east of Ridge Rd.

approve on second reading, seconded by Mr . Segrave.  Motion carried.  Voting “yes” –  all

governing body: Mayor Collins.  
 
ORDINANCE – 2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of

present. Comment was made by the following member of the governing body: Mayor Collins.  
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
